headline: GTCO 9M Pre-Tax Profit Slips 2.3% on Higher Funding Costs
summary: Guaranty Trust Holding Company Plc recorded a 2.32% decline in pre-tax profit to N879.90 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared with N900.80 billion in the prior-year period.
why: GTCO is a prominent financial services group operating across West Africa, reflecting broader banking sector trends in the region.

impacts.name: Guaranty Trust Holding Company Plc
impacts.why: Rising funding costs created a drag on earnings for the nine-month period.
